*GitHub Releases · Qwen Code* | 11/08/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: model_release, evaluation, api_update

> <h2>Highlights</h2> <ul> <li>Added ACP support for configuring reasoning effort levels from Default to Max via session configuration. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8526" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8526/hovercard">#8526</a>)</li> <li>Clicking uploaded or pasted images in the Web Shell now opens a preview in the artifact panel with download support. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8930" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8930/hovercard">#8930</a>)</li> <li>Fixed AutoFix timeouts by enabling streamed progress output to detect active work during long-running headless tasks. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8895" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8895/hovercard">#8895</a>)</li> <li>Fixed Desktop Local Control to support enterprise LAN addresses by allowing non-private IPv4 routes on verified interfaces. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8866" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8866/hovercard">#8866</a>)</li> <li>Improved Web Shell responsiveness by fixing animation stutter, scrolling stability, and line-change statistics for large files. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8915" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8915/hovercard">#8915</a>, <a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8914" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8914/hovercard">#8914</a>, <a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8924" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8924/hovercard">#8924</a>)</li> <li>Fixed Windows bug where the desktop app failed to spawn the Node runtime due to unhandled verbatim path prefixes. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8936" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8936/hovercard">#8936</a>)</li> </ul> <h2>Breaking Changes</h2> <p>No known breaking changes.</p> <h2>Complete Change List</h2> <h3>Features</h3> <ul> <li>OpenAI API log cleanup now applies to non-interactive sessions, headless invocations, and daemon modes to reduce disk usage. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8893" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8893/hovercard">#8893</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/doudouOUC/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/doudouOUC">@doudouOUC</a></li> <li>Web Shell session lists now share cached data across components to improve loading performance and reduce network requests. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8891" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8891/hovercard">#8891</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/doudouOUC/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/doudouOUC">@doudouOUC</a></li> <li>Added ACP support for configuring reasoning effort levels, allowing clients to set options from Default to Max via session configuration. ## [datasette-upload-dbs 0.5a0](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/11/datasette-upload-dbs/#atom-everything)
*Simon Willison's Blog* | 11/08/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: model_release, api_update

> <p><strong>Release:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/simonw/datasette-upload-dbs/releases/tag/0.5a0">datasette-upload-dbs 0.5a0</a></p> <p>This plugin has been around for a while - it lets users upload a brand new SQLite database to a hosted Datasette instance, at which point that database will start being served by that instance.</p> <p>It can also be used to atomically swap a database with a more recent version. The uploaded database is saved to a file, verified, then swapped in so <code>/name</code> starts serving the new one.</p> <p>The new release adds a formalized API, so you can replace an existing database (or add a new one) like this:</p> <pre><code>curl -X POST \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \ -H "Accept: application/json" \ -F "db=@content.db" \ -F "db_name=content" \ https://your-instance.example.com/-/upload-dbs </code></pre> <p>This means you can build fresh databases in an environment such as GitHub Actions and swap them in production as soon as that build has completed.</p> <p>Tags: <a href="https://simonwillison.net/tags/datasette">datasette</a></p>
